tailwind-variants.message: These three read tailwind-variants' MODULE-LEVEL twMerge config, which only a called tv() factory writes — so they merge with an UNCONFIGURED tailwind-merge until some unrelated module happens to load, silently dropping our custom --text-*/--leading-*/--tracking-* classes. Import cn/tv from @orb/ui/lib (packages/ui/src/lib/class-merge.ts owns the ONE config). createTV is deliberately NOT banned — class-merge.ts is its one caller.

patterns.message: Dead legacy dnd-kit stack. Use @dnd-kit/react + @dnd-kit/helpers (ui-package-design §3, work-order item 15).

D12 (the contract namespace is `session` singular; there is no `sessions`). The ledger killed this specifier by name — a reintroduction is banned; drop it or contest the D-cite in its docs/adr/ decision. Pinned by tests/tooling/verify/lib/ledger-banned-shapes.int.test.ts.

dotenv was killed 2026-08-03 (node-26 adoption program §3) and is no longer installed. node:util's parseEnv IS the platform .env parser; foundation/env/index.ts owns the ONE loader (and the override merge process.loadEnvFile() cannot express). Nothing else reads a .env.

deniedGlobals.Buffer: `Buffer` is a node global that does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users. tsc will NOT stop you: `types: []` (tsconfig.base.json) only suppresses AUTO-inclusion of `@types/*`, and it cannot suppress the `/// <reference types="node" />` that DEPENDENCY .d.ts files inject — vite's own index.d.ts for the @orb/ui program, pino-std-serializers/undici-types (reached through the client->server `import type { AppRouter }` edge) for @orb/client. Measured 2026-09-05 (#1312): every global denied here typechecks clean in both programs. Use Uint8Array / TextEncoder / TextDecoder / atob / btoa.
deniedGlobals.setImmediate: `setImmediate` is a node global that does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry for why `types: []` is not a program-level guarantee). Use queueMicrotask() for a microtask or setTimeout(fn, 0) for a macrotask.
deniedGlobals.clearImmediate: `clearImmediate` is a node global that does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Pair setTimeout() with clearTimeout() instead.
deniedGlobals.global: `global` is the node global object and does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Use `globalThis`.
deniedGlobals.__dirname: `__dirname` is a node CommonJS global that does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Browser code has no filesystem path; use `import.meta.url` when you need module-relative resolution.
deniedGlobals.__filename: `__filename` is a node CommonJS global that does not exist in a browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Browser code has no filesystem path; use `import.meta.url` when you need module-relative resolution.
deniedGlobals.require: `require` is a node CommonJS global that does not exist in this ESM browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Use a static `import`, or `await import()` when the load must be lazy.
deniedGlobals.module: `module` is a node CommonJS global that does not exist in this ESM browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Use ESM `export`. (A LOCAL binding named `module` resolves to that binding, not the global, and is not flagged.)
deniedGlobals.exports: `exports` is a node CommonJS global that does not exist in this ESM browser bundle — referencing it ships a ReferenceError to users, and tsc accepts it (see the `Buffer` entry). Use ESM `export`. (A LOCAL binding named `exports` resolves to that binding, not the global, and is not flagged.)
